description: Combine exact near-field gravity from molecular-dynamics-style neighbor lists with Barnes-Hut or fast-multipole far fields. The result is a minimal simulator that keeps close passes crisp without paying O(N^2) everywhere.
mathematical_formalization: a_i = sum_{j in N_i(r_n)} G m_j r_ji / (||r_ji||^2 + eps_i^2)^(3/2) + M_theta(Far(i)); choose r_n, theta so that ||delta a_i|| < eta
analogical_connections: Verlet lists in molecular dynamics become exact near-field shells for gravity.
Terrain level-of-detail becomes force level-of-detail through multipole summaries.
An audio crossover network suggests splitting force into local high-frequency detail and distant low-frequency bulk.
implementation_hypothesis: Build `cells = hash_positions(x, h)`; accumulate exact forces from adjacent cells; build a tree over cell centers of mass; evaluate far cells with Barnes-Hut or FMM; fallback to dense pairwise summation when `N` is below a direct-sum threshold.
experiment_seed: Benchmark 2-body, Plummer-sphere, and ring scenes at N in {16, 128, 1024}; compare wall-clock time, force error, and orbit drift against direct summation and pure Barnes-Hut.

closest_prior_art.title: REBOUND: An open-source multi-purpose N-body code for collisional dynamics
A hierarchical O(N log N) force-calculation algorithm
A fast algorithm for particle simulations

novelty_claim: The novelty is the interface boundary: the simulator is organized around an explicit near/far split that matches interactive workloads, rather than around a monolithic research code or a single global approximation.
differentiation: Barnes-Hut and FMM accelerate all interactions, while molecular-dynamics neighbor lists usually assume short-range cutoffs. This concept fuses them for gravity by keeping local exactness without pretending the force law is actually truncated.
experimental_result: Deferred after Phase 3 synthesis and benchmark review: the small-N audited kernel already meets the claim, while the performance branch would read like crowded Barnes-Hut/REBOUND territory.
